headlines.title: $300,000 in Duke Energy, Philip Morris and Johnson & Johnson: Here’s What It Pays
headlines.summary: One utility, one tobacco giant, and one healthcare Dividend King each get $100,000 to see who earns the most. The ranking surprises, and one stock's 64-year raise streak comes with the lowest payout of the three.

headlines.title: Altria vs. Philip Morris: Higher Income Now or Faster Dividend Growth?
headlines.summary: Two tobacco giants pay out nearly identical shares of their earnings, yet one yields almost twice as much as the other. For retirees choosing between them, the real question is what each payout costs in risk and future growth.

headlines.title: Buy, Sell, or Hold? Tuesday’s Top Upgrades and Downgrades: Cloudflare, Deckers Outdoors, DraftKings, MongoDB, Nike, Oneok, Philip Morris International, Riot Platforms, Wix.com, and More
headlines.summary: A two-day rally built partly on short covering faces its first real test when October inflation data lands at 8:30 ET. Meanwhile, analysts flipped hard on Wix and DraftKings, while a surprise double upgrade lifted a bitcoin miner's target.

headlines.title: Philip Morris International (PM) Stock Looks Reasonably Priced On Earnings
headlines.summary: Philip Morris International has delivered a powerful 5 year run, which now puts its earnings front and center for anyone trying to judge whether the current share price makes sense. With that kind of track record already on the table, the question is how much of the story is now captured in the valuation you see today. The stock has returned 181.7% over 5 years. This raises a clear question about how strongly investors are pricing the underlying earnings power.

headlines.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Philip Morris International Stock?
headlines.summary: Despite Philip Morris International’s strong performance relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a cautiously optimistic outlook on the stock’s prospects.

description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
